description: This file defines a React functional component 'TeamInfoView' for displaying and managing team details within a web application. It includes functionalities for viewing team overview, members, permissions, and settings, as well as editing options, member management, and API interactions for fetching and updating team data.

methods.name: fetchTeamInfo
methods.description: Fetches team information from API and updates state.

methods.name: fetchOrganization
methods.description: Fetches organization data related to the team, if available.

methods.name: getOrganizationModels
methods.description: Determines which models to present based on organization and user models.

methods.name: handleMemberCreate
methods.description: Handles adding a new team member via API call.

methods.name: handleMemberUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating a team member's details via API call.

methods.name: handleMemberDelete
methods.description: Triggers confirmation modal to delete a team member.

methods.name: handleDeleteConfirm
methods.description: Confirms and executes deletion of a team member.

methods.name: handleTeamUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating team settings via API call with form data.
